scenes.text: Quiz time! 6 tricky questions, from episodes 50 to 58. [1] Five seconds each. Count how many you get right. [2] Ready? Let's go!
Question 1. Why does a chatbot conversation cost more as it gets longer? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] The whole history is resent every turn, so every message adds more input tokens.

data.question: Why do long chats cost more?

scenes.text: Question 2. In our agent loop, we keep looping while the stop reason is what? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Tool use! While the model keeps asking for tools, we run them, and loop again.
Question 3. Chunks of 200 words, moving forward 150 each time. How much do they overlap? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] 50 words! 200 minus 150.
Question 4. In FastMCP, what tells the AI what a tool does? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] The docstring, and the type hints! They become the tool's description.

data.question: FastMCP: what describes a tool to the AI?

scenes.text: Question 5. In our voice bot, which library turns speech into text? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Whisper! pyttsx3 speaks, sounddevice records, and Streamlit builds web apps.

data.question: Which one turns speech into text?

scenes.text: Question 6. In a deployed Streamlit app, where should your API key go? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] In the host's secrets settings. Never in your code, or on GitHub.

data.question: Where does the API key go?

scenes.text: So, how many did you get? [1] 6 out of 6? You're a true AI Maastaaru! [2] 4 or 5, great work. [3] 3 or less? Rewatch episodes 50 to 58, and try again. [4] Comment your score below!
